plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Society, Ethics, and Law (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn2] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. No more than 3 hours of PHIL 484 may be used. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
[grid1 fn3] Select from JWST 465/RELS 465 , PHIL 282 , PHIL 314 , PHIL 315 , PHIL 376/FILM 376 , PHIL 381 , PHIL 385 , PHIL 470 , PHIL 480 , or PHIL 482 .
[grid1 fn4] Select from COMM 302 , COMM 307/JOUR 301 , COMM 317/JOUR 317 , CSCE 402 , MGMT 209 , POLS 306 , POLS 320 , POLS 340/PSAA 340 , POLS 353 , POLS 355 , POLS 462/WGST 462 , SOCI 304 , SOCI 317/AFST 317 , SOCI 328 , SOCI 338 , SOCI 412 , SOCI 413 , SOCI 421/WGST 421 , SOCI 422 , SOCI 445 , or an approved version of PHIL 491 .
[grid1 fn5] Students must complete an approved internship involving 150 hours of work in a professional setting. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn6] Students may substitute PHIL 491 Research with departmental approval.
